articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset
articles.description: After Seth Trimble led Louisville to a 72-64 win over No. 5 Texas Tech, Cardinals coach Pat Kelsey told critics of teams using fifth-year players, "Everybody can have their opinion. Bring it."

article.headline: Allen scores 20 as Illinois State beats Tulsa 79-67
article.description: — Nick Allen helped lead Illinois State past Tulsa on Tuesday with 20 points off of the bench in a 79-67 win.
article.linkText: Allen scores 20 as Illinois State beats Tulsa 79-67

categories.description: Illinois State Redbirds @ Tulsa Golden Hurricane

event.description: Illinois State Redbirds @ Tulsa Golden Hurricane

keywords: Illinois State Redbirds @ Tulsa Golden Hurricane
article.story: PALM DESERT, Calif. -- — Nick Allen helped lead Illinois State past Tulsa on Tuesday with 20 points off of the bench in a 79-67 win. Allen shot 7 of 7 from the field and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Redbirds (4-4). Malik Moore scored 19 points and added five assists. Chase Walker shot 5 of 9 from the field to finish with 11 points. Myles Rigsby finished with 16 points, six rebounds and four steals for the Golden Hurricane (4-3). Tulsa also got 12 points from Kaleb Banks. Illinois State took the lead for good with 16:41 remaining in the first half. The score was 37-35 at halftime, with Moore racking up 12 points. Illinois State pulled away with a 9-0 run in the second half to extend a two-point lead to 11 points. Allen led the way with a team-high 13 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
